additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0430123-DC/Si-D/DE-[Null]Secc is offline CRM:02681000285
additional_info.body:
Hello Steffen,
Greetings of the day!
Please note that r
egarding the “SECC is offline” message, I’ve reviewed the logs, and it appears that the SECC lost communication for a few seconds at that time.
This disconnection is momentary—usually resolved within 5 seconds as the Controller automatically re-establishes the connection. Importantly, this event has no impact on the charger’s operation, including during active charging sessions.
During this time, an "SECC is offline" flag may appear on your backend, but it will be cleared once the reconnection is successful.
There were successful charging sessions carried out after that as well on this charger.
Do let us know if you have any other queries?
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut
